POSTING EXPERIENCE "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"Myself vaishnavi, intern welcome to my medicine blog journey where am gonna share my experience in medicine department\u003Cdiv\u003ENOTE: THIS IS AN ONLINE E LOGBOOK TO DISCUSS OUR PATIENT'S DE-IDENTIFIED HEALTH DATA SHARED AFTER TAKING HIS\/HER GUARDIAN'S SIGNED INFORMED CONSENT. HERE WE DISCUSS OUR INDIVIDUAL PATIENT'S PROBLEMS THROUGH A SERIES OF INPUTS FROM THE AVAILABLE GLOBAL ONLINE COMMUNITY OF EXPERTS INTENDING TO SOLVE THOSE CLINICAL PROBLEMS WITH COLLECTIVE CURRENT BEST EVIDENCE-BASED INPUT.\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EWhen am in third semester i used think what is medicine?NTG so special only thing we do is ask history and prescribe medicine but when am going through posting and interaction with PGS and SRS related to case taking, examinations, interlink various symptoms and subjects, etiopathogenesis and to diagnose patient just by looking his features which add on by investigation taught that it is vast and amazing subject\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHere am going to share my interesting and knowledgable cases\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EWhile i was looking patient to take history and examination i saw a 14yrs old boy with an low mood about his condition, i thought why not talk to him and support him. And the case is about\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ehttps:\/\/chvaishnavirollno28.blogspot.com\/2022\/11\/14-yrs-male-child-with-spleenomegaly.html\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThrough this cases i learned about\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1. OPSI (OVERWHELMIMG POST SPLENECTOMY INFECTION) where patient is prone for capsulated bacteria(h. Influenze, meningococcal, pneumonnococcal-most common) as spleen is major organ for recticuloendothilial system. For which need for vaccination scheduled as\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EElective - 2weeks before splenectomy\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EEmergency - vaccine is given an post operative day 1 or 2. If vaccine is given after surgery, antibody tirer are less\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2.Post splenectomy complications?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EEarly:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E• Haemorrhage\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EInjury to stomach, splenic flexure, pancreas\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDelayed:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFistula from stomach, pancreas\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESubdiaphragmatic collection\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELeft basal atelectasis and pleural effusion\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThrombocytosis- thrombotic complications\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E• OPSI- H influenzae, Meningococcus\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-Hematological changes\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETransient - increase in RBC, increase in WBC (confused with infection) increase in platelets in first 2weeks of splenectomy\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPermanent changes -\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHowel jolly bodies, basophilic stippling, hyperpigmented WBC, reticulocyte in peripheral smear, these are persist life long in splenectomised patient\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3.Splenomegaly causing pancytopenia as it is reticuloendothial system.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-Differential diagnosis for pancytopenia\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPancytopenia refer to reduction of all threee cells of blood i. E RBC, WBC, PLATLETS.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECAUSES OF PANCYTOPENIA\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Evitamin b12, iron and folic acid deficiency\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHypersplenism, aplastic anemia, leukemias, bone marrow infiltration by carcinoma, lymphoma, multiple myeloma, overwhelming infection\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAnd another case i seen is Clinically distress 40yrs old female\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ehttps:\/\/chvaishnavirollno28.blogspot.com\/2023\/05\/a-40-year-old-women-with-chest-pain.html?m=1\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELearning points-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1.How triglycerides cause abdominal pain and acute pancreatic?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHigh level triglycerides with associated comorbidities like diabetes is major cause for acute pancreatitis after alchol and gall stones. It induces inflammatory process which leads to acute pancreatitis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2.different types of DIABETES? What is LADA?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELADA is characterized by adult-onset diabetes and circulating autoimmune antibodies; thus, patients may present clinically with characteristics of both type 1 and type 2 diabetes (2–5). Typically, the clinical features of type 1 diabetes seen in LADA include a lower BMI compared to what is typical in type 2 diabetes and autoimmunity against one or more of the following antibodies: islet cell autoantibodies (ICA), autoantibodies to glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD), tyrosine phosphatase–related islet antigen 2 (IA-2), and insulin autoantibodies (IAA) (4,5). The characteristics of type 2 diabetes that may present in LADA include older age at onset and insulin resistance or deficiency. Characteristics of LADA tend to include an intermediate level of β-cell dysfunction between those in type 1 and type 2 diabetes, faster decline of C-peptide compared to type 2 diabetes, and a level of insulin resistance that is comparable to type 1 diabetes (4). β-Cell decline is variable in LADA, as measured by C-peptide levels\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAnother case of patient with fever associated with multiple ulcers all over the body\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ehttps:\/\/chvaishnavirollno28.blogspot.com\/2023\/01\/35-year-old-female-with-fever-and.html\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELearning points\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1.How methotrexate toxicity leads to pancytopenia?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2.Methotrexate cause folic acid deficiency\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3.methotrexate toxicity treatment?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EStop taking methotrexate and give iv infusion with leucovorin glucardipase with folic acid supplemention.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E4.features of methotrexate toxicity?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr
